decision: authorize one bounded normal-boot validation window after fresh admission matches
execution_conditions: Recheck fresh admission immediately before lock; drift means zero device writes.
Use these exact frozen files; bind4 before lock, explicit remaining-budget check before mkdirs and backup, guard immediately before backup/control writes and each reboot.
Record every rc. UI wrapper final rc is not proof: inspect individual raw rc and output before the next action.
After any nonzero write or reboot rc only read back to determine actual state; do not resend uncertain writes.
Begin restoration no later than 1200 seconds from real LOCK; release by 1800; never reset epoch.
No T38, REA, debugger, induced exit, signals, manual guardian launch, stop clearing, old object deletion or other board actions.
verification_scope: Plan/source/hash/syntax reviewed. No device execution, full contract PASS, close-reopen acceptance, white-screen fix or sealing claimed.
retained_objects: T48 objects unchanged; T52 new stage and backup may be retained with identities and reason.
